title: add benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v148
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Add new profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v148; improves kernel-selection telemetry for long-sequence workloads; adds representative workload runners and dashboards; no breaking API changes.
description: Motivation: the benchmark lab needs repeatable profiling baselines and a reporting pipeline so we can track regressions across kernel-selection and adaptive-batching changes. This PR introduces: 1) profiling baselines for v148 (cold-start, steady-state, memory pressure scenarios); 2) representative workload runners for long-context summarization, chat replay, and high-concurrency embedding loads; 3) a reporting pipeline (Airflow + ETL) that aggregates run traces, perf counters, and baseline deltas into our telemetry warehouse; 4) dashboards and alert rules for regression detection. Changes are backwards-compatible with existing harness configs. How to run locally: ./benchmark-lab/run_local.sh --suite v148; see benchmark-lab/README.md for env and sample payloads. Checklist: - [x] Add profiling baselines and runner configs - [x] Add Airflow DAG + ETL job + unit tests - [x] Add dashboards and alert rules - [x] End-to-end test against staging cluster - [x] Docs updated (README and quickstart) Related work: ENG-2891 for baseline targets, ENG-2907 for reporting schema. Links: benchmark-lab design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2891/profiling-baselines-design , dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/benchmark-lab-v148. Notes: initial CI run flagged a flaky integration test in the runner (fixed in second commit by adding a retry and increasing the grpc timeout).
commit_summary: add v148 profiling baselines and representative runners | add airflow DAG and ETL for reporting pipeline | fix flaky runner test (increase grpc timeout + retry) | add dashboards and README updates
review_comments: Miguel Torres (reviewer): Please add a brief note about expected noise in memory measurements and how we normalize across instance types. Asha: added normalization notes to baselines.yaml and updated README. Lina Zhang: The ETL job looks good but can we split the transform into smaller functions for testability? Asha: split aggregate_baselines.py into transform + io helpers and added unit tests. Kenji Mori: CI flagged a flaky test on first run; please ensure retry/backoff is limited to avoid masking real regressions. Asha: implemented bounded retry (3 attempts) and added a comment explaining rationale; reran CI — all checks green. Miguel: approved. Lina: approved with comment to follow up on alert thresholds in a separate PR. Kenji: approved. Merge: squash and merge after green CI and 2 approvals.
notes: This PR standardizes the baseline schema used by the kernel-selection telemetry team. Follow-up tasks: ENG-2950 (automated weekly baseline runs) and ENG-2951 (per-model alert tuning).
